title: Org-targeted AI triage flag in a ticket intake
name: AI ticket triage gate

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code decides which organizations get a targeted flag? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
An operator disables ai_triage in the repository. How quickly do running instances stop using AI triage?
choices: Immediately, because every call reads the repository
Only after a restart, since the cache never expires
After a delay of up to the cache TTL (30 seconds by default) per instance
Never, because a cached disabled flag is treated as missing

questions.prompt: For an org with ai_triage enabled, the AI service throws a timeout error. What happens to the ticket?
choices: It is routed with the keyword rules, and the AI failure is not logged anywhere
The error propagates and the ticket is left unassigned
It is retried against the AI service until it succeeds

questions.prompt: When allowedOrgs is "*", which organizations get the flag?
choices: Organizations whose plan appears in the flag's plans list
None, because "*" is not a valid org ID
